label: Mint instance token
description: Hand a browser or extension a token that acts inside one instance of this program, and nothing else: it starts that instance's runs (in the `Weft-Instance-Token` header on a live route), answers its waits, shows its displays and connects its accounts. It always expires. The value comes out once; keep it only where whoever uses the instance can reach it.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance, by the id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: expiresInHours
inputs.description: How long the token works, in hours (a year at most).

outputs.name: expiresAt
outputs.description: When it stops working, in unix seconds.
